G: Share of the energy given to electrons at one depth that is left a distance x deeper (per unit distance)
K_col: Collision kerma of the primary photons
Phi: Fluence of primary photons at the surface
R: Farthest distance the electrons reach (in the even spreading model, the distance the energy is spread over)
T_max: Kinetic energy of the most energetic Compton electron
beta: Ratio D/K_col past the buildup in the model (transient charged particle equilibrium)
chi: χ²: the sum of squared differences in units of the uncertainty
d_max: Depth of the dose maximum in the model
e: Euler's number, the base of natural logarithms
k: Photon energy in units of the electron rest energy, hν/m_ec²
mu: Linear attenuation coefficient of water for the photons
mu_en: Mass energy absorption coefficient of water (with ρ: μ_en/ρ, NIST)
x: Distance from where an electron starts to where its energy is left
z': Depth where the electrons are set moving
